description:
FreeAttack – dein deutscher Minecraft Bedrock Server

FreeAttack is a German-language Bedrock network with multiple servers under one address: Lobby, Freebuild, Mining, and Minigames. Homes and warps work on all servers—typing /home takes you directly to the correct server.

Features

• Clans with their own abbreviation, clan chat, clan treasury, and leaderboard (/clan)

• Mailbox: Letters containing items and money sent to every player, even offline (/mail)

• Season Pass with XP levels and rewards (/pass)

• Auction House

• Minigame rounds count toward levels and quests

• Daily vote reward (/vote)

• Refer friends and both of you get a reward (/referral)

• Tutorial for new players

• Link your Discord account (/discord link)

Website: freeattack.net
